<?php
class ScopeBase235 { public function capture($value) { echo self::class,"/",static::class,";"; return $value; } }
class Scope235 extends ScopeBase235 { public static function launch() { global $owner; $owner->MiSsInG(((new self)->capture(...))(true)); $owner->MiSsInG(((new parent)->capture(...))(true)); $owner->MiSsInG(first:((new static)->capture(...))(true)); } } class ScopeChild235 extends Scope235 {}
class ScopeMagic235 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return 9; } }
$owner = new ScopeMagic235; ScopeChild235::launch(); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
function shift235() { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; }
class PacketBase235 { public $saved = 0; public function __construct($value) { $this->saved = $value; echo "CTOR;"; } public function capture($ignored) { echo "METHOD;"; return $this; } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class PacketScope235 extends PacketBase235 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG(((new static(7))->capture(...))(shift235())); } } class PacketChild235 extends PacketScope235 {}
class Owner235 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner = new Owner235; $child = PacketChild235::launch(); echo "RETURN;"; echo ($child->saved[0] instanceof PacketChild235 && $child->saved[0]->saved === 7) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
class StaticBase235 { public function __construct() { echo "CTOR;"; } public static function capture($value) { echo "METHOD;"; return $value; } public function __destruct() { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "SELECTOR;"; throw new Exception("stop"); } }
class StaticScope235 extends StaticBase235 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG(((new parent)->capture(...))(later235()),false); } } class StaticChild235 extends StaticScope235 {}
function later235() { echo "LATER;"; return 1; } class FailedMagic235 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return 9; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner = new FailedMagic235; $result = 0; try { $result = StaticChild235::launch(); } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CATCH;"; } echo $result === 0 ? "HELD;" : "BAD;";
